description: Example requirements on the landing time, for the landing windows and the slip tolerance (docs/contract/SPEC.md, section 5.6).
notice: EXAMPLES chosen by the team to show the mechanism. They are not requirements of NASA or of any mission. A requirement is an input of a scenario: a user may state any other one, and a viewer must show the label of the requirement next to every number derived from it.

requirements.label: EXAMPLE chosen by the team, not a NASA requirement: Earth in view at landing and 10 Earth days of unbroken sunlight from landing
EXAMPLE chosen by the team, not a NASA requirement (stricter): Earth in view at landing, 14 Earth days of unbroken sunlight from landing, Earth in view for at least half of those 14 days
EXAMPLE chosen by the team, not a NASA requirement (looser): Earth in view at landing and 5 Earth days of unbroken sunlight from landing
